tokens.name: cs-bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the dark wells inside widgets: valuebox, spinner input, fader and hfader rail, xy pad, switch track (off). SCSS $cs-bg, CSS var(--cs-bg).

tokens.name: cs-surface
tokens.usage: Panel body (.patcol) and the active tab. SCSS $cs-surface.

tokens.name: cs-surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panel title band (.patlabel), footer (.instfooter), secondary buttons, select options, status badges, dropdown control and menu, spinner buttons. SCSS $cs-surface-2.

tokens.name: cs-surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of surface-2 controls; the knob's unfilled arc; Bootstrap $secondary. SCSS $cs-surface-3.

tokens.name: cs-border
tokens.usage: 1px borders of wells, buttons, badges, dropdowns and tabs. Contrast is decorative only: 2.54:1 on cs-bg, 1.78:1 on cs-surface, 1.42:1 on cs-surface-2 (below the 3:1 a control border needs; kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: cs-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and control text on every surface: 16.1:1 on cs-bg, 11.2:1 on cs-surface, 9.0:1 on cs-surface-2, 7.3:1 on cs-surface-3. SCSS $cs-text.

tokens.name: cs-text-muted
tokens.usage: Panel and footer titles, units, tick marks, muted badge, spinner arrows: 7.9:1 on cs-bg, 5.5:1 on cs-surface, 4.40:1 on cs-surface-2 (panel titles sit there at 12.5px: just under 4.5:1, kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: cs-accent
tokens.usage: Yellow accent: widget labels (.dbyellow), xy pad handle, links, focus borders of inputs: 9.9:1 on cs-surface, 14.2:1 on cs-bg. SCSS $cs-accent.

tokens.name: cs-blue
tokens.usage: Primary actions and active state: fader handles, selected select option, panel switch on, knob value arc, primary button fill (white text on it: 5.15:1). As a mark it is 3.7:1 on cs-bg but 2.59:1 on cs-surface (fader handles) and 1.68:1 against the knob's cs-surface-3 arc.

tokens.name: cs-success
tokens.usage: Status dot of an ok badge (Csound, Audio), with a 6px glow: 5.96:1 on cs-surface-2.

tokens.name: cs-warning
tokens.usage: Warning button fill (Start audio, black text 10.3:1) and the loading badge dot.

tokens.name: cs-danger
tokens.usage: Error badge border and dot, pending (unsent) spinner text. Only 2.01:1 on cs-surface-2: the badge always carries a word too.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Numeric read-outs (valuebox, spinner, xy values) and text on cs-blue; the switch thumb when on.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on cs-warning (Bootstrap's computed contrast colour).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link colour on hover (Bootstrap $link-hover-color).

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Site footer band in _layout.scss ($color-primary); not shown on the instrument page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline of the panel switch and Bootstrap's focus ring: cs-accent at 40%.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip bubble behind widget labels (the source writes rgba(50,50,50,127), which renders opaque).

tokens.name: handle-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of fader and hfader handles: white at 55%.
